scope: end-to-end per-record serving latency: input normalization -> local redaction -> TF-IDF construction -> inference -> decoding -> JSON serialization
not_included: model fitting/training time; vectorizer fitting; accuracy metrics (timing predictions are not used for any metric)
record_order: locked_split.csv locked-test rows in file order
input_normalization: NFKC + whitespace collapse (identical for all methods)
redaction: regex rules from common.py (identical to code_reference/redaction.py)
student_config: selected lambda 0.25, seed 20260715, refit in memory (no checkpoint saved/loaded)
baseline_configs: selected hyperparameters (validation-only), seed 20260715, refit in memory
